snippet.title: SPELLISIMO - Official Reveal Trailer | Mobile Magic RPG
snippet.description:
Cast spells by drawing runes. Duel friends in real-time. Conquer dungeons in this magical mobile RPG. ⚔️ 🔮                                                                                                                                                    
                  
🎮 PRE-REGISTER NOW: https://spellisimo.com                                                                                                                                                (Coming to iOS & Android — May 2026)
 
About Spellisimo:
Spellisimo is a mobile fantasy RPG where every spell is cast by drawing its rune with your finger. Master a growing spellbook of fire, earth, lightning, and arcane magic. Battle players in turn-based duels, conquer increasingly deadly dungeons, and climb the leaderboards.                                                                                                                                                                            

✨ FEATURES     
  • Gesture-based spell casting — draw runes to cast                                                                                                                                           
  • Turn-based PvP duels against players worldwide
  • Procedurally challenging dungeons with boss fights                                                                                                                                         
  • Deep gear and attribute progression                                                                                                                                                        
  • Guild system with shared bonuses and chat                                                                                                                                                  
  • Free to play                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                           
  🔗 LINKS                                                                                                                                                                                     
  • Website:  https://spellisimo.com
  • Discord:  https://discord.gg/spellisimo                                                                                                                                                    
  • Twitter:  https://x.com/spellisimo
  • TikTok:   https://tiktok.com/@spellisimo                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                               
  📩 Support: hello@spellisimo.com
